_comment: Update manifest for the app's startup update check (issue #85). 'latestVersion' is bumped automatically by the update-manifest workflow when a GitHub Release is published; 'minimumSupportedVersion' is bumped MANUALLY, only to retroactively flag an old build unsafe (a running build below it is hard-blocked in-app). Always keep minimumSupportedVersion <= latestVersion. Before the first release these stay 0.0.0, which the app reads as 'nothing newer, nothing unsafe'.
